purpose: Freeze final paired validation after all declared development and independent audits finish; no final conditions have been run
selection_rule: Classical only: strict success, then task success, then full horizon, then lower safety excess, final XY error, full-horizon RMSE, alphabetical tie-break. Development selection only, not a ranking of algorithms. All historical baselines and named student seeds remain included regardless of their development result.
formal_rule: Only selected models with unchanged development task/strict success qualify for the separate dt=5e-5 resolution test. Eligibility is frozen before the four final conditions.
limitations: Same scene/interface does not equalize prior training or parameter count. Ordinary and feature-matched RNN are separate methods; warm starts and additional updates are disclosed. All nonselected development candidates remain in the appendix.
